{{Top|leg}}
'''Vron''' was a commentator on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Cron commented on the entry for [[KZZ riot armor]], noting that [[Security Police/Legends|Espos]] wearing the armor were as feared as [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]].<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
